text: Plan updated: Phase 3 (measured accuracy) added: fal transcription, formula check, transcript-aware board reading, diagrams redrawn or cropped, consistent terms, test set + scoring. Kept generic across subjects.
Demo clip added (5 min, MIT OCW). Supabase project created in London with the schema and demo users. Anthropic and fal keys configured; app stays in offline mode until a live run is approved.
Phase 1 complete: D (backend & API) merged after two fix rounds. All five workstreams on main: 535 server + 97 web tests pass. Phase 2 (integration) starting.
E (frontend) merged after one fix round. main: 350 server + 97 web tests pass. 4 of 5 workstreams merged; D in its final fix round.

C (audio & PDF) merged after lead security fixes; CI now installs Chromium for PDF tests. main: 350 tests pass. D: tests and security pass after fixes, code re-review running. E: fixing review findings.
MVP ready to try: full student and lecturer interface on sample data (E, PR #5). E now in review. Lead hardened video duration limits on main.
C: security and tests now pass; code review asked for small changes (Opus fixing). D: independent tests pass; code and security reviews asked for changes (Opus fixing).
Merged A (video & frames) and B (board AI & notes) into main: 179 tests pass. Remaining work restarted on Opus (Sonnet only writes the independent tests): C security fix, D review, E frontend.
Build session stopped again; unfinished work saved. B passed all re-checks; D backend built (PR #4).
A (video & frames) verified after one fix round: code review, 31 independent tests and security review all pass. Ready to merge.
First reviews done for A, B, C: 130 independent tests written (A and B all pass; C 3 failing on LaTeX injection). All three in fix round 1, mainly medium security findings.
A (video & frames) built: PR #3, make check passes; now in review.
C (audio & PDF) built: PR #2, make check passes; now in review. B: first checks asked for changes, fix round starting.
Build resumed with tiered models: Sonnet builders and reviewers, Opus security review and escalation. Frontend running separately for an early test version.
Previous build session stopped mid-run; all unfinished work saved as WIP commits. B (board AI & notes) finished: PR #1.
Phase 1 started: agents A–E building in parallel, each followed by code review, independent tests and security review.
Progress dashboard live; local Postgres running via Podman.
Phase 0 committed: contracts, offline AI fakes, pipeline interfaces, schema, CI, docs.
Private GitHub repo created: AhmedBlackEye/boardnotes.
Figma design system and prototype finished (21 components, 11 screens, 2 flows).
